Subject: SIG intake — SDLC evidence request

Hi Ben,

As part of GreenBank's SIG assessment intake, our assessor asked for a compact set of SDLC artifacts related to your code review, CI/CD controls, secrets/keystore handling, and documented change approvals. The assessor is focused on the last 12 months but specifically asked for examples that show enforcement and exception handling.

Requested items (can be redacted where necessary):
- Code review policy + one representative code-review manifest (PR list with approvals)
- CI run logs for a release (including any guardrail/failure remediation entries)
- Evidence of ephemeral credential usage and keystore rotation events
- Change approvals/rollout notes for one canary -> general rollout (audit trail)
- Any playbooks for emergency/rollback procedures

Deadline: can you share a curated bundle (PDF + attachments) by end of day 2027-09-07? Our assessor prefers a single shared folder and a short narrative that ties artifacts to your internal controls.

Thanks — let me know if you need clarification or a short call.

Alice Wu
Senior Security Assessor
GreenBank Security
